title: DaVinci IQC Portable Vaporizer (taxes extra)
description:
The DaVinci IQC Vaporizer

DAVINCI IQ3 NOW AVAILABLE

The well designed DaVinci IQ gets a USBC upgrade.

Highlighting Clean First technology, Temperature Control, App Connectivity, Replaceable Battery, and USB-C charging, this dual use vaporizer has it all.

Main Features:
USB-C Charging
Airtight Zirconia / Glass Vapor Path
LED Grid Communication plus Bluetooth App
5 Year Warranty

Extra details:
Precision Temperature to 430°F / 221°C
30 Second Heat up Time
Removable 18650 Battery
0.5g oven capacity for dry herbs
Heavy Metals Tested

Glass Lined Ceramic Heating Oven
DaVinci’s alumina ceramic, glass lined oven boasts a + or – 1 degree temperature accuracy for vaporization.

Precision Temperature Control + Smart Paths
Precision mode, temperature degree control, and smart path mode make using the vaporizer an easy and guided experience.

Sealed Zirconia/Glass Vapor Path
No metals or plastics are used on our sealed zirconia/glass vapor path providing purity to the connoisseur.

Removable / Rechargeable Battery
18650, 3000 Mah battery, up to a 2 hour run time making your vaporizer portable. Carry extra batteries so that you can still use your vaporizer on those out and about days.

Type C Charging
Charge in as little as 2 hours. Reverse charging capability powers up your phone on the go.

BONUS ITEMS: 4 PIECE PREMIUM GRINDER, 2 CLEANING STICKS, 1 BRUSH

Includes
1x DaVinci IQC
1x 18650 Battery
2x Stickers
1x Vaporizer Users Manual
1x 10mm Water Adapter
1x Extra Pick Tool
3x Alcohol Wipes
1x Brush Tool
1x 3ft Braided Nylon USB To Type-C Cable
